_comment: Where a generated skill lands per AI host. Only the destination path and the layout vary; the skill body is identical. Placeholders: {project} (project root), {home} (user home), {index} (the index folder), {name} (skill name). Layouts: skill-folder (Agent Skills folder with SKILL.md), merge-block (a marked block merged into a shared instructions file, hand-written content preserved), zip (a zip of the skill folder for upload). Re-verify these conventions against each host's current documentation when they change.
